claims.claim_text: Toyota Motor Corporation is a beneficial owner of >10% of voting interests, has board designation right, and supplies parts/materials for subassembly components. Joby paid Toyota $1.3M in 2023 for parts and materials.
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: Toyota Motor Corporation ( Toyota ) is a beneficial owner of more than 10 % of the voting interests of the Company and has the right to designate a director for election to the Company s Board of Directors. Toyota is developing prototypes and supplying parts and materials for some of the Company s manufactured subassembly components. The Company made payments to Toyota for these parts and materials totaling $ 1.3 million during the year ended December 31, 2023.

claims.claim_text: Delta Air Lines entered an umbrella agreement, invested $60M in shares (11,044,232 shares at $5.4327), and received a warrant for up to 12,833,333 shares with milestone-based exercise.
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: In connection with the umbrella agreement that the Company entered with Delta Air Lines, Inc. ( Delta ) on October 7, 2022, the Company sold and issued to Delta, in private placement, 11,044,232 shares of the Company s Common Stock, at the per-share purchase price of $ 5.4327 , for an aggregate cash consideration of $ 60.0 million.

claims.claim_text: Joby operates a 130,000 sq ft prototype production line and aircraft assembly / flight test facility in Marina, California (leased from City of Marina).
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: We operate a powertrain and electronics engineering and manufacturing facility in San Carlos, California, as well as 130,000 square feet of additive and subtractive manufacturing, machining, aircraft assembly and flight test facilities in Marina, California.

claims.claim_text: Joby has identified a 140-acre site in Dayton, Ohio as planned high-rate production facility, supported by state/local incentives.
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: Our high-rate production facility is planned for Dayton, Ohio where we have identified a 140-acre site that has the potential to support significant growth over time, with enough land to build over two million square feet of manufacturing space.

claims.claim_text: Joby began initial service operations with the U.S. Department of Defense (USAF customer) in September 2023, delivering its first aircraft.
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: We began initial service operations with the U.S. Department of Defense ( DOD ) in September 2023 and are targeting commercial passenger operations in 2025.

claims.claim_text: Joby has a partnership with Uber (an investor) for aerial ridesharing service relationship.
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: Our preparations for commercial passenger service include forming sector-leading relationships with partners such as Toyota, Uber, Delta Air Lines, and SK Telecom in South Korea, all of whom have invested in Joby

claims.claim_text: Joby is developing proprietary eVTOL aircraft technology including all-electric powertrain, redundant flight control systems, and battery systems — implies meaningful patent portfolio in electric aircraft / eVTOL / motors / batteries.
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: We have spent more than a decade designing and testing a piloted all-electric, vertical take-off and landing ( eVTOL ) aircraft... Our aircraft has been specifically designed with multiple redundancies across systems and components

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom invested $99.9M in a June 2023 private placement (15,037,594 shares at $6.65); ANA Airlines (Japan) named as global partner.
claims.subject: Joby Aviation
claims.source_quote: in June 2023, the Company received $ 99.9 million for the issuance of stock in a private placement to SK Telecom, Co., Ltd., a corporation organized under the laws of the Republic of Korea ( SKT )
